attacks.effect: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 100 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

sv02-206.name: Quaxly
sv02-206.description: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

attacks.name: Apply Gel
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.

sv02-207.name: Quaxwell
sv02-207.description: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

sv02-208.name: Frigibax
sv02-208.description: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

sv02-209.name: Arctibax
sv02-209.description: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

sv02-210.name: Baxcalibur
sv02-210.description: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.

abilities.name: Super Cold
abilities.effect: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Basic {W} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

sv02-211.name: Raichu
sv02-211.description: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

attacks.name: Electrocharge
attacks.effect: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic {L} Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.effect: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

sv02-212.name: Mismagius
sv02-212.description: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.

abilities.name: Magical Flick
abilities.effect: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may move an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

sv02-213.name: Gothorita
sv02-213.description: This Pokémon will hypnotize children to put them to sleep before carrying them away. Be wary of nights when the starlight is bright.

attacks.name: Mind Bend
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

sv02-214.name: Sandygast
sv02-214.description: If it loses its shovel, it will stick something else— like a branch—in its head to make do until it finds another shovel.

sv02-215.name: Rabsca
sv02-215.description: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

attacks.name: Revival Blessing
attacks.effect: Put a Pokémon from your discard pile onto your Bench.

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

sv02-216.name: Tinkatink
sv02-216.description: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

attacks.name: Scrap Pickup
attacks.effect: Put an Item card from your discard pile into your hand.

sv02-217.name: Tinkatuff
sv02-217.description: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

attacks.name: Play Rough
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

attacks.name: Pulverizing Press
attacks.effect: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

sv02-218.name: Paldean Tauros
sv02-218.description: This kind of Tauros, known as the Combat Breed, is distinguished by its thick, powerful muscles and its fierce disposition.

attacks.name: Raging Horns
attacks.effect: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Combat Tackle
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

sv02-219.name: Sudowoodo
sv02-219.description: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.

attacks.name: Hit and Hide

sv02-220.name: Nacli
sv02-220.description: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

attacks.name: Salt Coating
attacks.effect: Heal 20 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

sv02-221.name: Paldean Wooper
sv02-221.description: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

attacks.name: Find a Home
attacks.effect: Search your deck for a Stadium card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

sv02-222.name: Tyranitar
sv02-222.description: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It is so insolent that it doesn't care about others.

attacks.name: Rout
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dread Mountain
attacks.effect: Discard the top 4 cards of your deck.

sv02-223.name: Grafaiai
sv02-223.description: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

attacks.name: Spit Poison
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Colorful Graffiti
attacks.effect: You may discard as many Basic Energy cards as you like from your hand. This attack does 40 damage for each type of Basic Energy you discarded in this way.

sv02-224.name: Orthworm
sv02-224.description: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.

abilities.name: Nutritional Iron

attacks.name: Shoot Through

sv02-225.name: Rookidee
sv02-225.description: This Pokémon is brave and reckless. The white markings around a Rookidee's eyes intimidate fainthearted Pokémon.

attacks.name: Send Back
attacks.effect: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

sv02-226.name: Maushold
sv02-226.description: They build huge nests with many rooms that are used for different purposes, such as eating and sleeping.

attacks.name: Gnaw Relentlessly
attacks.effect: Put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Pokémon for each of your Maushold in play.

sv02-227.name: Flamigo
sv02-227.description: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that the energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

abilities.name: Insta-Flock

attacks.name: United Wings

sv02-228.name: Farigiraf

attacks.name: Either Face

sv02-229.description: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.
